description: Source code for OSDP (Open Supervised Device Protocol) implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including UART communication, buffer management, and device context setup.

classes.name: osdp_device
classes.description: Structure representing an OSDP device with buffers, UART configuration, and state flags.

methods.name: osdp_handle_in_byte
methods.description: Handles incoming bytes, detects packet start sequences, and manages buffer insertion.

methods.name: osdp_uart_isr
methods.description: UART interrupt service routine handling RX and TX events.

methods.name: osdp_uart_receive
methods.description: Receives data from the device buffer.

methods.name: osdp_uart_flush
methods.description: Resets buffers and sets device to wait for start mark.

methods.name: osdp_build_ctx
methods.description: Builds and initializes the OSDP context with device parameters and connected PDs.

methods.name: osdp_refresh
methods.description: Periodic thread function to update OSDP state.

methods.name: osdp_init
methods.description: Initializes UART, buffers, context, and starts the refresh thread.
